subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
cluster: Forces at a distance and materials

items.prompt:
An electric current produces a ____ around a wire.
A) magnetic field
B) sound wave
C) rainbow
D) shadow

A changing magnetic field in a coil produces an
A) electric current
B) sound
C) shadow
D) smell

An electromagnet is magnetic
A) while current flows
B) only when cold
C) never
D) only at night

steps: It is magnetic only while current flows.

items.prompt:
A compass needle moves near a current-carrying wire. This shows current produces a
A) magnetic field
B) sound
C) shadow
D) smell

steps: The moving needle shows a magnetic field.

items.prompt:
A generator makes electricity by
A) moving a magnet near a coil
B) heating water only
C) burning fuel directly into wires
D) shining light
items.answer: A) moving a magnet near a coil

items.prompt:
A steady, unchanging magnetic field in a coil produces
A) no current
B) a huge current
C) a sound
D) light

steps: Only a changing field produces current.

items.prompt:
A bulb on a coil lights only while a magnet moves in the coil because
A) moving the magnet changes the field, producing a current
B) the magnet is hot
C) the bulb has a battery
D) a still magnet makes the most current
items.answer: A) moving the magnet changes the field, producing a current

steps: Only a changing field makes current.

items.prompt:
The two-way connection between electricity and magnetism is that
A) current makes a magnetic field, and a changing magnetic field makes current
B) they are not connected
C) only current makes magnetism
D) only magnets make current
items.answer: A) current makes a magnetic field, and a changing magnetic field makes current
